name: railhorn

patterns.description: Wind-up line telegraph across arena, then high-speed charge. Sidestep is the skill check.
Stomp at end of charge or standalone — expanding ring shockwave. Jump the gap / step inside late.

intro_notes: Clear trash beat → WARNING banner → camera punch → fight. Gold chest on kill.
notes: Boss 2 (~10:00). Charge + slam — arena clamp optional. Harder pattern than Rico Bloom. Sprite placeholder: res://assets/sprites/enemies/railhorn.png
